representation_options.name: FIXED_THETA_BINS_WITH_BOUNDED_FRONT_SLOTS
persistent_state: front positions/depths associated with fixed water-content bins
front-type/activity masks required to distinguish infiltration fronts, falling slugs and groundwater-connected fronts
only genuinely physical hysteretic/event state if proven necessary
representation_options.strength: fixed-size SoA-friendly storage can be designed if maximum active front slots per bin/profile is proven
representation_options.hard_open_question: published bookkeeping does not yet prove that a simple one-front-per-bin persistent representation covers all arbitrary forcing histories

representation_options.name: DYNAMIC_FRONT_POOL
persistent_state: active front records in a per-column bounded pool or compact indexed slab
representation_options.strength: closer to native event representation and can avoid storing inactive bins
representation_options.hard_open_question: requires a mathematically justified hard pool bound; overflow may not silently discard or merge physical water

non_admissible_design: unbounded linked-list/vector growth per logical column under arbitrary wetting/drying history

advance_trial_interface.signature: advance_trial(base_state, parameters, forcing, boundaries, t0, t1, physical_config, numerical_config, workspace) -> trial_result
advance_trial_interface.rollback: discard complete trial front/bin state and scratch; committed state remains untouched

required_services: pressure head or qualified reconstructed representative head
solute-transport water volumes and face fluxes
process_hydraulic_view.qualification_rule: If a requested process quantity cannot be reconstructed to sufficient fidelity from the FWC state, that process combination is outside the FWC applicability envelope. Other modules may not be rewritten around front internals.

mass_contract.identity: storage_change = top_in - top_out + bottom_in - bottom_out - sinks + sources + explicit_internal_component_transfers_that_cancel_pairwise
mass_contract.front_events: front creation, collision, merge, layer crossing, groundwater contact and binwise diffusion redistribution must each have a local transfer ledger whose sum is exactly conservative

boundary_contract.moving_groundwater: groundwater-connected fronts may represent capillary response, but the imposed boundary head remains coupler-owned rather than duplicated as private state
boundary_contract.direct_modflow: accepted step returns one conservative q_SWAP for imposed H_MF and supports the reverse flux-imposed trial semantics required by coupling qualification

response_tangent_candidate: Differentiate active front-velocity/event equations and event-free substep maps. Tangent must be marked unavailable or treated piecewise at front collisions, merges, limiter switches or topology changes; many +/- full reruns are not the intended production path.

runtime_contract.diffusion_extension: explicit binwise diffusion adds bounded arithmetic only if bin and substep counts are bounded; published use of 200 bins is evidence, not a production default
